literal: Pleasure he who desires not, work he who desires, his relations' suffering having wiped away, propping up pillar.
translation: He who does not seek personal pleasure but desires only to do his work will become a supporting pillar that wipes away the suffering of his kin.
modern: இன்பத்தை விரும்பாமல் தன் கடமையாகிய செயலைச் செய்ய விரும்புகின்றவன், தன் சுற்றத்தாரின் துன்பத்தைத் துடைத்து அவர்களைத் தாங்கி நிற்கும் தூண் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the noble quality of a person dedicated to effort and duty. One who disregards personal ease and instead finds joy in hard work becomes a source of strength for their family and friends. By actively working, they wipe away the distress of their relatives and stand firm as a supportive pillar, bearing the weight of their community's welfare.
